lines.english: "…! It's over…"
"Hey, hang on, Sugiura!"
"To think you'd just disappear the very moment class is over…"
"Ogiso…"
"We still have last period, don't we? Though I guess they don't take attendance anymore."
"I don't think you should be talking to me. It might end badly for you too, Ogiso."
"Well, whatever. By the way, Sugiura, you know about my sister, right? You know, you saw her on the live DVD of the previous school festival."
"Hmm? You don't remember? I'm referring to the one where my sister was the singer and Touma Kazusa was on the keyboard…"
"Well… what about it?"
"Hey, are you free this Sunday?"
"I have my part-time job."
"My sister's birthday happens to be next Monday, you see."
"I don't have the slightest clue what you're trying to get at from this conversation…"
"We're having a birthday party for my sister this coming Sunday, so if you don't mind, why don't you come over? See, that's what I'm getting at."
"…Why?"
"My sister's friends from university will be coming too. That's why you don't need to feel so reserved about this."
"…Did those university friends of hers happen to ask you to invite me? Did they ask you to directly introduce me to Ogiso-senpai?"
"Hmm? What are you talking about, Sugiura?"
"Right back at you. What are you talking about…"
"Like I said, I'm just asking if you would like to come to the party. That's all I'm trying to say, you know?"
"Then why are you asking me?"
"Because you've looked out for me a lot as a fellow class rep. …Is that not an adequate reason?"
"Sugiura?"
"I'm sorry, Ogiso. I didn't mean to be suspicious about your intentions. I really have been rather unpleasant lately…"
"My sister's not all that amazing, but her cooking is pretty good, and she might even tell us more about Touma Kazusa."
"So she's good at cooking…"
"You're also already accepted into Houjou University, right, Sugiura? They'll all be your upperclassmen, so you may even be able to talk to them and end up learning something useful."
"That's… true…"
"Right? So it's on Sunday at 5 o'clock in the evening…"
"But sorry, I really have part-time work."
"…Is that so…"
"Send my regards to your sister. Tell her I wish her a happy birthday."
"Yeah, I got it."
"Goodbye. See you next week."
"Yeah, see you."
"What's wrong?"
"I was just thinking that it's been a while since I properly greeted someone in school."
"I see… so it's her birthday…"
"Haah…"
"So that's what you were up to…"
"And here I was wondering just what on earth you were up to, acting so sneakily behind our backs…"
"W-W-What do you mean… I don't think I have anything to feel guilty for…"
"You're trying to make us and her make up, aren't you?"
"You wouldn't have invited us to your sister's birthday party or anything if not for that reason."
"No, that's… You two told me before that you wanted to meet my sister, right…?"
"Well, it's true that I want to see her at least once… Your sister can almost be considered a legend around the school, after all, Ogiso."
"Well, no matter how you look at her, she's just a normal university student, though."
"Still, attempting to use that invitation as bait to deceive us is just so unfair."
"…You two are the ones who are being unfair, now, aren't you?"
"Ogiso-kun…"
"Was this the outcome you two desired? To make Sugiura the black sheep of the school, and to graduate with your friendship broken…"
"Yeah, that's exactly right. And things have gone splendidly…"
"Sayuri!"
"The truth is, you two are actually scared, right? Despite the fact that you two started all this, the rumors got exaggerated to the point of getting out of hand…"
"…I'd never have imagined it either. I've always thought that such an atmosphere was foreign to this school, being a relaxed school for the rich."
"Y-Yeah. To be honest, even I didn't expect things to turn out like this…"
"But you can't deny that it was the two of you who started this, right? To hurt someone you considered a close friend just yesterday to such an extent…"
"What should we do…? Hey, Sayuri, why don't we…"
"…Then, what about Mihoko?"
"What are we going to do about her, given that she's been completely betrayed by the person she considered her best friend just yesterday and still hasn't been able to recover from that fact?"
"B-But… if you judge things solely based on what Yada said…"
"That's why we tried to hear things straight from the horse's mouth. And yet she…!"
"She didn't deny it…"
"And that's not all! Despite everything we said to her, she's still…"
"She's still continuing to betray Mihoko, you know! She keeps meeting up with that university student time after time, you know!"
"I'm sorry, Senpai! I didn't mean to make you wait!"
"Uwaa!?"
Koharu sprinted through the ticket gate of the station 30 seconds before the time we arranged to meet, and without slowing down, she ran into my chest.
"Haah, haah, haaah… I was really anxious～! I spent so much time preparing, the train I was supposed to ride on left right in front of me…"
"I was anxious too… just a moment ago, that is."
Though I expected Koharu to be lightweight as usual, the combination of her unusually lively speed along with how unexpectedly heavy she felt caused me to stagger three steps backward.

"Still, I took my time when I was getting ready, so I'm perfectly prepared this time. Look, I brought three sets of clothes, pajamas, a brush, and a hair dryer. I also brought a facial cleanser, a nail clipper, ear picks, and a phone charger…"
"You're not used to traveling, are you?"
What a heavily equipped sleepover set… It's not a wonder why she had that much more kinetic energy earlier.
"…How about we go look for a locker first? It'll be hard for us to go shopping with all this."
"It's fine, I'll carry it all for you. It'd be a waste to spend 300 yen for one or two hours."
"Wow, you can even hold it with one hand… You're strong～!"
"Well, I am a man, after all."
…Though it was actually so heavy that I felt a sharp, overwhelming pain run through my right hand for a moment.
"Then I'll take care of your other hand. …Shall we go, Senpai?"
And with my free left hand being held by both of Koharu's hands, my right hand will have to endure the pain of lifting her overstuffed luggage for the next one or two hours.
The long exam period is finally over, and tomorrow would mark the start of an even longer spring break.
And although the high school's spring break only starts in March, the general public has three days off starting from tomorrow, including a national holiday.

That's why Koharu properly changed into her casual clothes this time, prepared whatever she needed to sleep over at my place, and rendezvoused with me in Onjuku, where it's unlikely that anyone would recognize us.
…And she's lied yet again, telling her parents that she would be going on a ski trip with her friends.
"Well then… let's buy our ingredients first, I suppose."
"I'll challenge myself to do the cooking this time, okay? …Though it might only serve to make me aware of our difference in skill."
"Not at all, my cooking is clearly amateurish to the point where I'd be thankful if it's edible, you know?"
"Ah, no, I'm not trying to compare it to your… You heard me?"
…Are you really that unconfident about this?
"After that… do you want to rent some movies? I don't have a game console or anything like that in my apartment, after all…"
"Ahh～ There's no need for that. I want to spend the entire time we're alone together just looking at you, Senpai."
"…You'll get tired of that, you know."
Given that both of my hands are occupied, I can't wipe away the sweat that I can imagine is spouting out of my forehead right now…
"I don't think so. We'll be busy with work in the daytime after all."
"…I suppose."
I can't tell if it's just typical of Koharu to insist on going to work during the day, even when she's staying over at a guy's apartment…
"We have to make sure we arrive at work at different times. Although we could always go home together…"
"…I guess so."
…Though I was kind of forced to accept the shift she signed me up for, of course.
"Somehow, rather than a sleepover, it seems we look more like we're preparing to live together."
"Eh, umm… Well, that aside, we sure will be busy… Are you really okay with a weekend like this?"
"It's fine, because there will only be the two of us at night. …I won't be alone."
The very moment she said that…
I could tell how Koharu meant two different things with her words from how desperately she's holding onto my hand.
"…Senpai, are you sure you're okay?"
"I feel like my shoulders have been partially dislocated…"
I'm holding Koharu's massive luggage in my right hand. And I'm holding three days worth of ingredients in my left hand. …I don't have a hand that Koharu can hold onto anymore.
Well, Koharu herself is currently holding some heavy-looking shopping bags, so it's not like the two of us can actually act like a couple right now.
"Sorry. After this, I want to check out this area for a little while."
"Ah, okay. What do you want to buy? I'll bring it to the cashier."
"Eh, well, but…"
"Senpai, your hands are already full, aren't they? And bringing that massive luggage into the shop will bother the other customers."
"B-But…"
"What is it? Is it on this shelf?"
"No… it's above those discounted items…"
"…Senpai, could it be that you have a slight cold?"
"I don't, actually…"
"Why didn't you say anything up until now? Could it be because you knew I wanted to stay over…?"
"Like I said, that's not it…"
"I really don't want you to be forcing yourself for my sake like this. I would've wanted you to be honest with me that you're not feeling well…"
"It's not the one on the top shelf…"
"Of course, I'd be sad if you told me not to come… but taking care of your own body is more important."
"It's on the second…"

"Ah, still, it's a good thing that I decided to come, now, isn't it? It's a good opportunity for me to look after you and provide you with constant attention. Why did you hide the fact that you were sick, Senpai!?"
"Like I said, it's not the cold medicine on the top shelf, I'm talking about the discounted items arranged on the second row!"
"Are you worried that it might infect me? Why do you always think of others so much… Second row?
…Eh?"
The pharmacy was located next to where the groceries were placed.
On the second row with all the discounted items, there are a dozen boxes packed neatly into packages of three.
"Th…That!? It's a c-c-c… Senpai!"
"That's why I told you I'm the one who should buy it!"
This amusing spectacle really didn't need to happen.
"Senpai, you're the worst…"
"It's your fault for being so nosy even after I said I could handle it myself, Koharu."
"You know what my personality is like… The truth is, you wanted me to buy it knowing that I would be shocked, didn't you? …What a bad joke."
Despite her complaints, and despite the fact that her face was completely and vividly red, no less, Koharu still went out of her way to make a stamp card for me…
"I do feel sorry."
"Anyway, if you told me beforehand what you were going to buy, I could've at least been a little more mentally prepared…"
"No, I was the one who was at fault before all this even started."
"Eh…"
"Well, I didn't really prepare appropriately… I didn't take the necessary precautions when it comes to you, Koharu."
"Senpai…"
Embarrassingly enough, by the time I realized that I didn't put one on when I was doing it with her, we had already finished.
"To do that to a girl who is about to enter universityーit was, well, really thoughtless of me…"
Well, it's not like I had anything like that with me in the first place, so it's not like I could've done anything about it even if I did realize that…
"That's why, well… what happened just now wasn't the worst thing I've done. It makes it the second worst."
"…Can we agree to drop the subject here?"
"Senpai."
"Y-Yes!"
"…I'd like you to go and take a stroll for a while. There's something I need to think about."
"…What is it?"
"Please do not pry any further. Well, I'll call you when I'm done."
"H-Hey, Koharu… Ah…"
Then, with the condom incident left unsettled, I looked at where Koharu was dashing to and concluded that I indeed didn't need to pry any further.
Because there were many stall carts lined up in the direction she ran to with flashy decorations and "Valentine's Day" written on them.
After leaving the underground grocery street, I walked around the shopping mall looking for a place to rest…
I remember that shop was somewhere in this building.
"Welcome… ah, it's nice to see you again!"
"…You actually remember me?"
"Of course. I'd never forget the face of a customer who's made a purchase here."
"Well, thank you for that…"
That can't be true, strictly speaking. Though to be fair, it'd be quite ridiculous of me to expect her to remember me after more than three years.
"What are you looking for today? I can accompany you for as long as you want, just like before."
"N-No, umm, that's…"
"…Alright, please take your time to choose. Call me anytime if you need anything, okay?"
"…Thank you very much."
The salesperson must have been perceptive enough to realize that my hesitation had a different reason compared to last time.
And that's why she doesn't stick too close to me and maintains an appropriate distance, unlike what happened last Christmas.
The last time I came here, I hesitated for two hours.
It wasn't about giving her a present that would make her happy, but more about giving her something that wouldn't upset her.
I was scared to become too distant from her, yet I felt a sense of guilt if I got too close.
While telling myself that I had to decide on one of them, I walked around in circles endlessly.
And now, we have drifted much further apart than ever before, with the heavy, unbreakable feelings of guilt continuing to envelop me, and before I knew it, her birthday has come about.
I think about what to give to her, and I'm perplexed by that very thought.
After all, I've decided not to meet her on that commemorative day.
"Senpai…?"
"Ah…"
That's why when Koharu called out to me, I…
I think I made a face like a kid who was caught red-handed.
"You were picking out… Ogiso-senpai's birthday present just now, weren't you?"
"Koharu…?"
However, compared to my half-baked feelings, the words that Koharu muttered shook me even more.
"Why did you leave without buying anything? We still had plenty of time."
"How do you…?"
"Because I've also been invited. To the birthday party of a certain someone's older sister, that is."
"Takahiro-kun…?"
"I thought he already knew everything at first. And I wondered if I'd end up being ganged up on again if I happened to brazenly attend it."
"That's not true… Takahiro-kun isn't someone that would do that…"
…Again?
"You're right. It seems that he just wanted to cheer me up. …I really can't hold a candle to him."
I also understand how she feels…
I'm sure that Koharu had to endure Takahiro-kun's kindness…
After all, kindness given from the members of the Ogiso family is simply too hard to bear for those who have strayed from their intended paths.
"You knew that it was Ogiso-senpai's birthday… but also that you couldn't celebrate it because of me, so you thought you could at least give her a present, right?"
"That's not what I thought."
"Let's…
give her a present, shall we?"
"It's fine, really. It's not like I give her one every year anyway."
"But since you refused the invitation, don't you think you should at least do that much…?"
"…Are you okay with that, Koharu?"
"Yes… because I get it now."
"What do you mean…?"
"Everyone has… different types of sincerity meant for different people."
"Which means…?"
"It'd be easy to be someone who anyone can get along with. …Though that was simply my own naive way of thinking about it up until last year."
The dazzling girl who doesn't feel ashamed about anything and sincerely believes in her own sense of justice…
"Even now, I don't think what I said is absolutely right, but it's more like I'm beginning to understand."
"Koharu…"
Has now become such a captivating woman… and all because of me.
"This weekend… you said that you wouldn't go to Ogiso-senpai's place and you'd stay by my side instead, Senpai."
I'm sure that's a sin that I've committed against her.
"That alone is enough for me."
And my greatest sin of them all was making her accept such a change within herself.
"Even though I was the one who fell in love with you, and even though I got hurt because of that, you still made many mistakes for my sake, Senpai."
"Don't put it in such a… sad way."
"It's because you're kind, Senpai… that you just can't bring yourself to leave me alone, right?"
"You're wrong… I…"
"I know that much. After all, you've never even said that you love me."
I never even noticed that.
"Still, that's only natural, isn't it?"
Even though such a simple phrase is so commonly used around us.
"You wouldn't usually just accept someone so easily when they suddenly say they're in love with youーespecially someone who's been so fussy around you all the time, right?"
But to think that such a phrase never came out of my mouth even once…
"And this is considering you still have someone you've cared about all this time, Senpai. Someone whom you're having a little falling out with right now."
…To think that only Koharu has ever said that phrase between us.
"But it'd only be strange if you could say that you love me so easily. …I wouldn't have fallen in love with someone so insincere."
"Koharu…!"
"The fact that you won't say you love me so easily is your way of being sincere. Even so, the way you hold me tight when I want someone to be kind to me is also how you're being sincere, Senpai."
"You're wrong, that's not…"
"I understand it now… Everyone has many… different types of sincerity, even toward the same person."
That was nothing but a convenient way for me to run away.
Koharu should absolutely not be saying things like this, not while she's being manipulated by the worst double standard there is…
"Hey, Senpai. Let's go back to that shop, okay? Let's choose a present for Ogiso-senpai, okay?"
"Then… you'll have to accept a present from me too, Koharu…"
"You can't do that, Senpai."
"Why…?"
"Because if you do… I'd have to take back what I've said just now."
"Koharu."
"After you."
Since we arrived at Minami-Suetsugu, Koharu has been following a few meters behind me.
I'm unable to tell just what she's trying to accomplish by doing this and how effective she is at doing so.
Even so, no matter how dark the shadow cast on her is, her passion and will refuse to bend, as always.
"…I'm back."
"…Welcome back."
"I've come back home. It's been a week since I've come into your apartment. …To where you are."
Though I suppose she may have only wanted to say those words.
"Welcome back… Koharu."
"Nhh… nhuu… S-Senpai… nmhuu…"
That's why, once the thin door separates us from the world, Koharu's feelings become uncontrollable.
"S-Senpai, Senpai… I, I'm…"
"I'm sorry, Koharu… for not giving you anything."
Our lips touched, she buried her face into my chest, and she broke down sobbing in the blink of an eye.
"Please don't worry about that, Senpai. After all, in exchange, I get to have you all to myself until Sunday."
"Yeah… I'm yours for the next three days, Koharu."
"I have a place to go back to… I'm in love… That's why I won't lose!"
"Mhm…"
"Senpai, nhaa, ahh… haah, ha-nhh… nhhh…!"
We desperately pour our strength into our numbed hands that were holding the heavy luggage, tightly and forcefully hugging one another.
Our three days of living together have only just begun, and yet…
The both of us desired one another so passionately right from the start, as if our final farewell was near.
"Allow me to repeat your order. One eggplant gratin, one Mediterranean-style risotto, and one drink set. Will that be all?"
"Then please enjoy. …Thank you very much! Please wait for a moment."
"Should I put the bill together? …Your total is 2580 yen."
"I've received 5000 yen. …Here's the return of 2000 yen first. Then here is the remaining 420 yen… yes, thank you very much～"
"…Kitahara-san. Please stop looking at her and focus on your work."
"…The Aglio Olio is done. Also, I don't know who you're referring to. You're someone who'll become the branch manager soon, so get a hold of yourself."
"Please don't make this into a quibbling match. You know I can't win against you, right, Kitahara-san?"
That Koharu…
She's completely different when she's working compared to when she's in bed.
Well, what's expected of her is still there, but apart from the obvious, her weak side seems to disappear the moment she puts on the Goodies uniform.
Perhaps Koharu thinks that this restaurant is one of the very few places she can stay strong with the way things are now.
"But you're right… Apparently, the branch manager will be going back to the headquarters. It seems he can't do jobs that require him to stand anymore."
"I see. Now that sounds terrible…"
"Yeah, it is… I won't be considered an 'acting' manager anymore. As for how soon, I'll be the branch manager starting in April."
"U-Umm… I don't know if I should give you my congratulations or my condolences…"
"…I appreciate either sentiment. I wanted to be a regular employee, you know? A regular employee…"
I was actually referring to the retired manager when I said "Now that sounds terrible," but it's too late to correct that now…
"W-Well, normally there are only one or two regular employees in every restaurant. …By the way, what about overtime payment?"
"Well, yeah… I'm prepared to a certain degree. …Though I'll look for a union first."
"W-Well… do your best. Try not to repeat the previous manager's mistakes."
"But since it's decided, I suddenly became uneasy about the restaurant's future. Especially regarding the retention of staff."
"…I'll make myself clear, but I'm already in the middle of looking for employment."
"I understand. I'm not talking about you, Kitahara-san. It's just that I don't want to let go of Sugiura-san."
"…It's not like I can do anything about that."
"It's clear that she has the ability to work in the dining area, but the way she works so seriously should also provide a good influence to the others working there as well."
"Don't just move on without addressing what I said…"
"Nakagawa-san is the kind of person who's quite popular but also quite lenient, so if Koharu can act as a substitute for her, this restaurant will be in a much better position, is what I think…"
"Well, she's a natural-born class rep, after all. You might've found a good catch."
"Thanks to your diligent training, she became a proper Mini-Kitahara. Be it her work ethics, mentality, size or…"
"I feel like the longer that sentence went on, the ruder it became."
"Anyway, I'm counting on you for this. I think that as long as you persuade her, Kitahara-san, she'll stay."
"You could at least listen to what I'm saying."
"Hey～ hey～ Koharucchi."
"I told you to stop addressing me that way… Moreover, you know that we're still in the middle of work, right?"
"There's nothing to do now, so isn't it fine? So Kitahara-san finally came back, huh?"
"It's because his university is on spring break. …It must be nice to have more than a month off."
"Good for you, Koharucchi. That means you two can act all lovey-dovey from now on, right?"
"Putting aside how you managed to arrive at that conclusion, I still have to go to school. There's still two more weeks of class before graduation."
"Ouch～! So you can only act all lovey-dovey on weekends. Perhaps you two can make out in the changing room or something."
"…Please don't talk about our workplace as if it's some place where we can fish for men. It's just inconsiderate."
"Then I suppose you two will be lovey-dovey after graduation? And you'll also be able to act all couple-like by spring when you two are on the same campus…"
"You should really stop with the whole lovey-dovey thing already. I'm really not in a bright and exciting romance or anything of the sort."
"…You seem quite composed about this, huh. You used to be more on the edge, always glaring at me when I talked about Kitahara-san."
"…I just thought I was tired of having to firmly deny you every time you try to falsely assume things about me, Floor Manager."
"Could it be that things actually went well? Are you so composed because you've finally become his girlfriend?"
"You're wrong. I'll take responsibility and deny that completely."
"Ah, I found a kiss mark."
"I got bit by a mosquito yesterday. In the middle of winter."
"…No matter how you look at it, that's clearly a lie."
"The kiss mark is also a lie, right?"
"Sheesh, you're always on your guard, Koharucchi～"
"Guard aside, nothing like that ever happened to me. Sorry to say this."
"Jeez～!"
"Jeez～ Nakagawa-san is so full of suspicion～"
"And yet you handled it pretty well."
She just proclaimed that she would surely cut her hands if she did it while talking, so I ended up cutting the ingredients while Koharu watches over the pot.

And after hearing her out, it became evident that Koharu actually doesn't have much cooking experience at all, after which I decided to take the safe route and settle with making curry, which I'm most confident in.
"I actually thought about her possible questions and prepared the answers to them beforehand. I even noted them down and memorized them…"
"I don't think you needed to go that far, though…"
"I'm no good at lying on the spot. I just can't seem to get on your level.
…Ah, it's starting to boil."
"…Don't try to get on that level. You're not supposed to grow in that way."
"There we go… I'll just let it simmer for a while now, right?"
"Don't forget to skim the fat. And keep an eye on the pot. I'll make the salad now."
"Y-Yes… leave it to me."
Up until now, she has shown how capable she is on various occasions, like in sports, studying, and in her part-time job, but now I've found something she's below average in.
…Well, it's simply due to a lack of experience. If she got serious, I'm sure she'd surpass me in a week.
"Do you enjoy your part-time job?"
"Yes, I think I've fit in quite well."
"…So it seems."
The fact that Koharu still doesn't miss any of her shifts even while she's staying over at my place demonstrates just how diligent she is.
"I only wanted to earn money for the trip with the girls at first, but I have a feeling that I've come to value the means over the ends."
"Is that so…"
Her strong sense of responsibility is probably one of the reasons why that's the case, though I can feel as if that's not all there is to it while she's working.
Notably, she's been letting out more frequent, natural smiles after work is over, which is something that's quite rare recently.
"…I've already lost my goal anyway."
"Eh?"
"I didn't say anything～"
It worries me how she immediately puts on her unnatural smile whenever she lets her guard down.
"It's hard to deal with Nakagawa-san sometimes, but she's reliable and likes to dote on me. I'm also able to get along well with the others now."
"Good, good."
"…Still, something bothers me. Although most of them have a longer career than me, somehow they lack ambition or look as if they only intend to work there temporarily."
"…I think you should dial down your criticism. Most of the folks working there are simply doing it for some extra money to spend."
"That's the case for me too, you know?"
"It's better if you stop assuming that everyone is like you."
It was a wall I crashed into about a year ago.
"Trying to do everything your way will only lead to pointless conflict. You'll have to put a certain amount of time into this."
In any case, it took me about half a year before I could properly balance my idea of reward and punishment.
…And even then, I've been told that I've been oppressively restricting myself.
"Even so… to think that I've been exposed to so much in three months despite only working during days off…"
"Well, unlike your height, your ambitions are quite tall, Koharu…"
"Stop using my height to put me down. There are still three classmates in front of me when we line up according to height in class."
"It's fine, isn't it? It's easier to pat your head this way."
"Don't think you can win me over without putting your words into practice."
"My bad, come here."
"…Try not to touch my head while your hands are wet."
Still, I'm glad… It seems she's in a much better mood compared to how she was yesterday.
I've had to bear witness to just how emotionally volatile she's been when I've been meeting her during the weekends lately, but the fact that she still has this place to return to is reassuring.
And although she hasn't gone out of her way to avoid talking to me today…
I can actually feel that she's truly enjoying herself while she's at Goodies, and it's something she feels from the bottom of her heart, and not only expressed in words.
"I can't say I don't have any complaints, but I really do enjoy myself.
…Which is precisely why there are also times where I've come to hate myself."
"Like I said, don't be too harsh on everyone…"
"You're wrong. I didn't mean it like that."
"Then, what…"
"I'm talking about myself, given that I can lie with a straight face to my precious colleagues whom I had so much fun with."
"For example… even though I'm spending the night in your room right now, I calmly told them that there's nothing between us."
"It's… the same for me."
"But… because I lie with such confidence, everybody starts to believe me."
That's indeed…
My relationship with Koharu was initially rumored to be more or less confirmed, but I've noticed that it's become more of a running gag lately.
"It seems that it's important to have confidence when you're telling a lie. I might actually be a natural liar."

Perhaps everything that has transpired is the result of us sweeping the topic under the rug with "okay, okay, let's just get back to work" and the fact that neither of us have gone out of our way to deny it.
"…Just like you, Senpai."
"…I'm sorry."
It's just as Koharu saidーshe's a liar right now.
"No… I'm the one who should be apologizing. I had no reason to bring you up there…"
And she's lying to just about everyone…
Whether it be her close friends, people that she can put her faith in, or even the very person she says she loves without hesitation, she can lie to them without batting an eye.
"That's not what I'm apologizing for."
"Senpai…?"
"I'm sorry that you've become a liar because of me…"
If not for the fact that I was so close to her, she wouldn't have needed to tell all the lies she did.
And through me, Koharu's gradually become really good at lying.
Before I realized it, the cutting sound of the knife on the chopping board disappeared.
The hot pot was filled with cold vegetables, so the water will take some time to boil again.
A moment of silence passed in the kitchen.
Now that I think about it…
Wasn't it because of Kazusa that I became a liar…?
I wasn't able to control my feelings for her. But the way she distanced herself so far away from me after inching the slightest bit closer only served to shake me to the core.
Every time I tried to give up, and every time I hoped that such feelings would just disappear on their own, she cluelessly went out of her way to distance herself from me…
And that's why, time after time, I've lied so horribly to the girl I loved and just started datingーto Setsuna.
In other words, I… perhaps I really have become good at lying, but I haven't grown as a person at all.
"Senpai… what are you thinking about?"
"…About you, Koharu."
"Right after you said all that…? You liar."
"I'm sorry…"
"Nhuu… nmuu…"
I realize that Koharu is trying her best to stand on her tiptoes as she's facing me.
Because I could feel her entire weight through her two hands on my shoulders.
"Nhh, mm…"
"Haah… nh, nchu… nn… haah… haah…"
That's why I naturally tilt my head to the side, leaning forward ever so slightly toward Koharu's exposed forehead.
In order to reach the same height as her lips.
"Nn, nhuu… haah… and now, I'm also a liar."
"Koharu…"
"Even though I'm doing things like this with you right now… I casually told them that nothing is going on between us, you know?"
"Yeah…"
"Since we're both liars… let's stop blaming ourselves, at least not at the moment, okay?"
"If that's what you want, Koharu."
"What I want right now is to continue where we left off for the time being…"
"Doing something like this while cooking is, well, how do I say this, a little too cliche?"
"It's alright, at least my ears are properly facing the pot. …So please continue until it boils."
"Okay…"
"Senpai…!"
"Haah, nhaa… haah… nhaah… aah, aah…"
"S-Senpai… aahh, I… can't…"
"Ahh, ah, ah… h-hya… ah, come, come…!"
"Ah, ahh… aahhhhh! Aahh, aaaahhh～!"
"Haah, ahh… Senpai, Senpai… nhh, nhaa… nmuuu…"
"Thank you."
"I received your present today, Haruki-kun."
"Thank you for the really wonderful pair of earrings. I'll treasure them."
"Even though I didn't give you a present in exchange for the one you gave me for Christmas, you still sent me another one. I'm so sorry for always being on the receiving end."
"Even though it was all my fault, and even though I did such a terrible thing to you back then…"
"Even so, the moment I realized that you still care about me, I was so happy that tears rolled down my cheeks."
"…I'm sorry. The fact that I'm making complaints in a text that was meant to express my gratitude makes you uncomfortable, doesn't it, Haruki-kun?"
"Don't worry about the party. It was my mom's idea in the first place, and Io and Takeya came over anyway."
"Rather, I feel bad that even though you're busy working, we're having fun here."
"I challenged myself to make a cake this year… and roast beef too. Since it's my first try, I'm not sure if it'll go well."
"Please do your best at work too, Haruki-kun. Don't push yourself too hard and risk your health, okay? It's still cold after all."
"Well then, good night."
"Even though it was all my fault," she says. "Even though I did such a terrible thing to you," she says.
You're wrong, Setsuna…
I'm the one at fault, and I'm the one who's done so many terrible things to you…
That's the reason why I've decided to give you that present.
I'm… just the same as you. No, I'm far worse…
"Ah…"
"I've… taken a shower before you."
As I remain on the bed with my arms around my knees and with my mobile phone still open…
I wonder what kind of expression Koharu's making as she's looking at me. I'm not able to tell with only the faint light spilling from the bathroom door.
"Ah…"
"…What?"
"I've… made another wound on you again…"
"Ah…"
In the darkness… Koharu's fingers gently caress my back.
Using the same fingers that had dug into the same spot with her sharp nails up until just a short moment ago.
"I'm sorry… I've done it again today…"
"It's fine. It's not a deep wound anyway."
"Lick… chu…"
"Ah… did I end up stinging it instead? I'm sorry, I…"
"Don't worry, it doesn't hurt. It just feels ticklish…"
She probably means to disinfect it…
This time, she covers the wound with her lips and slowly licks it with the tip of her tongue.
"It's fine, you can continue. Thank you, Koharu."
"O-Okay. Chu… chu…"
…Using the same mouth which left teeth marks on my shoulders up until a short moment ago.
"Lick… nn, nmuu, haah… I can taste… your blood, Senpai."
"Like I said, I'm fine. Your nails aren't long anyway."
"It's not because I was in pain. It's just, I mean… I never felt that way up until recently… My neck was quivering, and my back was trembling, so I just unconsciously…"
"I see…"
Does that mean…
"I wonder… what's happening to me…? I'm just a bit scared."
"That's not something… you should worry about, I think."
On the contrary, as a man, this is something to be happy about… probably.
"Say, Senpai… Next time we do it, could you tie up my hands?"
"Don't be silly. I can't do something so horrible."
Because that's not my fetish… But it's scarier that she said that, unaware of it's meaning.
"But… what if you get tetanus from some bad bacteria from my nails…"
"You don't need to worry that much. It won't happen if you wash your hands properly before that. …As well as my body which you're about to touch."
"Does that mean… starting from now, every time before we do it, we should take a bath together?"
"…It'll be the same if we take a bath separately."
"And it will be the same… if we do it together, right?"
"…Let's sleep. We have the morning shift tomorrow."
"Yes… good night."
Koharu said that she might have become a fool last night, and those words somehow possess a sense of reality to them.
However, the basis of her thought process was so naive and pitiful, I could only lightly chide her for saying it. In that, I felt a slight sense of frustration at my lack of vocabulary.
Yeah, it was rather frustrating.
Her response was supposed to be that of delight, of love, and yet, I wasn't sensitive enough to give her a serious reply.
"…Are you asleep already?"
"There's no way I am. Not even ten seconds have passed."
"I'm sorry… Hey, Senpai."
"What?"
"That text you got earlier… it was from Ogiso-senpai, right?"
I'm truly frustrated. I'm frustrated about how I'm so cowardly that I'm not able to say anything right now.
"So she already received the present? Was Ogiso-senpai happy with it?"
I'm frustrated about how I'm so weak that I can't even answer a question she just asked me.
"You shouldn't worry too much about me. There's no point in hiding Ogiso-senpai from me, right?"
I'm frustrated about how I'm so pathetic that I've been forgiven by Koharu before I could even say anything.
"I chose the present with you, right? Then why are you hesitating at a time like this?"
About my terrible self, who is unable to move forward or backward, and in the end, is only pushed forward by Koharu.
"Moreover, I wished for this to happen despite knowing how you feel about Ogiso-senpai, you know?"
Although that was Koharu's wish according to her own words, I haven't been given any reason to believe them.
I don't understand anything.
Be it Koharu's true feelings or what she truly wishes for.
"If you want to be bothered about something, think about Ogiso-senpai. Think about her, because you can't meet up with her for a while due to my selfish desires.
"Just sleep already… You're saying too many weird things right now, Koharu."
Therefore, on top of my terrible actions, I paint another awful layer over it.
"…It really is weird, isn't it? I must have said a lot of terrible things."
"It was weird, but not terrible. …That's enough now."
I can't even reassure the person who is in the same bed as me.
I can't stop her from being hurt by her own words.
"You're just repaying your debt to me, Senpai."
"You're wrong."
"I've tried my best to become an escape for you, but it didn't seem to work, and as it backfired, you pitied me, and this time you've become a place where I could retreat to."
"I said you're wrong…"
"That's why even if it's just for this moment, it's fine…"
"Koharu…"
"When I become strong again, and when everything has settled down… you can go back to Ogiso-senpai."
"Koharu…!"
Hearing her sobbing behind my back, I turn around and hold her to my chest.
As a spineless coward, this is the only comfort I can give her.
"It's fine… Just don't think about anything and try to sleep."
"Then… keep embracing me like this. Don't turn your back on me."
"…Sorry. Until the night is over, I'll watch over your face constantly, Koharu."
"And… please give me an arm pillow. So that I won't cry again tonight."
"Got it… Good night."
"Good… night."
Koharu's head rests on my left arm while my right hand caresses her damp hair which she had just washed.
I continue to attentively gaze at her adorable face in the darkness.
Until the tears from her eyes disappear and her breathing becomes regular as she falls asleep.
No… until the night is over, as I promised.
"Are you alright?"
"I-I'm fine, sorry. I'll remake it."
I cleaned up the scattered ingredients and threw away whatever was left in the garbage bin while I was at it.
After washing the frying pan, I dry it by heating it up and pour a light splash of oil into it again.
Then I take a new pack from the refrigerator, cut it open, and throw its contents into the pan…
Today, I'm spending another monotonous day in the kitchen of Goodies…
"Isn't it tough doing everything with your right hand?"
Leaving aside the fact that I can't use my left hand.
I must really lack muscular strength if I can't use my arm after something like that. I might even lose in an arm wrestling match with Koharu at this rate.
"You can take a break if you want. We can hold out somehow with the way things are now."
"No, I can't do that…"

"When you've become only as useful as everyone else, it doesn't hurt if you just rest a while, Kitahara-san. …Though I must say it's quite disheartening to see you only as efficient as everyone else."
"…Sorry. Give me just ten minutes."
Is it just simple muscle pain? Or has my blood circulation not returned to normal?
There are a lot of things on my mind right now, some of which I regret, particularly my decision to act tough and actually provide her with my arm as a pillow up until morning.
But I had no choice but to do it back then. …More importantly, I wanted to do it back then.
"Haaah…"
I close my eyes slowly as I recall the fact that I never managed to shut them throughout the previous night.

How much time passed until Koharu finally managed to fall asleep soundly and peacefully after shutting her eyes with her head on my arm? I really couldn't tell while I was still in that eternal darkness.
I wasn't sure if the quiet sounds coming from her were of her sleep talking, her heaving sobs, or just sniffling.
I watched Koharu the whole time until morning as I promised I would, alerted by even the slightest change of sound.
…To put it more accurately, I did so until Koharu had clearly woken up and pestered me for a good morning kiss.
That's right… I didn't leave Koharu's side for even a moment last night.
"Re: Thank you."
"I'm glad it has arrived safely. …I suppose I should say that it's just a cheap trinket, as usual."
"I know it's a bit early, but… happy birthday."
"I apologize that I can't even show up to celebrate an event that only happens once a year."
I feel a nauseous sensation rising in my chest from my own self-loathing.
Although Koharu permits me to do this, I'm still doing it behind her back.
Although I said I'm Koharu's until tomorrow, I'm still getting in touch with Setsuna through our written words.
I know full well that I've done terrible things to both of them, but the guilt in me drives my fingers to continue typing on the keys of my phone.
"Roast beef, huh… looks like you've gone and raised the bar. Isn't that a dish that's quite difficult to properly make?"
"Now that you mention it, the first time I ate your homemade cooking was when you made your Hamburg steak, right, Setsuna?"
"The truth is, I was actually nervous back then as if it were a natural reaction, and though I can't really remember how it tasted anymore, I only remember I asked for seconds."
"…What am I saying? It's strange of me to be suddenly talking about the past, isn't it? I actually don't even know what I want to say at this point."
"For now, I pray that your roast beef will turn out great. Talk to you later."
The moment I pressed the send button, my line of sight became distorted, almost brutally so.
It's not like I'm physically unwell. Everything other than my left arm is in the pink of health.
It's just because I… watched over Koharu till morning as promised.
"Haa-aaah…"
I think I'm suffering from a slight lack of sleep.
"Senpai?"
"You'll catch a cold, you know?"
"Go to bed if you want to sleep. Or you could at least cover yourself with a blanket."
"H-Huh…?"
The first thing my five senses picked up was a high pitched voice that sounded like a bell, tickling my ears.
Next came the scent of the spicy curry, which has been left simmering for a day.
After that, artificial light started to pierce my eyes, and soon my vision began to clear…
"Koharu…?"
"Good morning, Senpai."
"I fell asleep, huh… What time is it?"
"It's almost midnight… It's only been about ten minutes since you dozed off."
"Ah…"
Despite the fact that I was tormented by a horrible sleepiness, I at least made sure to do my best in the kitchen until the restaurant closed.
After that, I cleaned up the place, returned to my apartment with Koharu under the guise of accompanying her to the station, and made a simple dinner from yesterday's leftovers…
…I don't have any memory of what happened after that.
"Sorry… I didn't mean to be like this while we're in the middle of sharing precious time alone together."
"You don't have to apologize. It doesn't change the fact that we're alone together."
"Still, I wasn't able to keep you company… Ah, I mean, it's not like I had an explicit reason why I wanted to do that…"
"…By adding that weird excuse at the end, you've made it seem like you actually do have an explicit reason in mind."
"…My bad."
It's not just because I was awake the whole time last night.
It's because I've exhausted myself emotionally over a long series of trials.
Though it's only been three days, I've been faced with the unbelievable reality of living with a girl.
And… with a suggestive reason.
Maybe it's because my daily life has changed drastically, but I have been feeling incredibly fatigued these daysーwhich is unthinkable for my usual self.
"You can go back to sleep, you know? I'm already satisfied just by watching your sleeping face, Senpai."
"I'm fine, I don't usually go to sleep at this time."
"Besides… I'll be kind and interpret your dozing off as you feeling relaxed around me."
"…To be honest, I'm exhausted because of how nervous I've been lately."
"Then… I'll be kind and interpret it in a different way. You dozed off because your heart just couldn't stop throbbing when you were around me."
"That has nothing to do with being kind. It's the plain and simple truth."
"Come on, help yourself to the bed. I'll watch over you for the whole night today. …Should I give you an arm pillow?"
"No, please don't do that. I'm advising you not to do so from the bottom of my heart."
After all, I still can't get rid of this numbness in my arm after half a day.
"…As someone who happened to use your arm as a pillow, I'd advise that you at least try it out once."
"Let's put that off until some other time for now."
…Even so, if she were to say that again the way she did one more time, I don't have the confidence that I'll be able to refuse her again.
After all, it's an embarrassing, captivating… and very important session of physical intimacy for the two of us.
"Welcome, Senpai…"
"This is my bed…"
As I answer her brusquely in an attempt to hide my embarrassment, I embrace Koharu's waist as she welcomes me onto the bed, though I wouldn't say the way I'm doing it is particularly appropriate.
I tightly hold her lower body, with my face buried in her thighs, satisfying myself with these warm and soft pillows.
"Rest well… Though, I will wake you up at 8 o'clock because we have work tomorrow."
"…After I fall asleep, make sure you get some proper sleep, alright, Koharu? Also, don't worry and just wake me up if you feel like crying."
"…I'm fine. I'm really fine now."
As if showing her strong determination, Koharu's voice doesn't waver.
"You've always been looking at me after all, Senpai. …You've been looking at me and me alone."
"Don't just assume things like that, and also try not to forcibly keep everything to yourself."
The way I spelled everything out so bluntly wasn't just because I was embarrassed.
"…I'll keep that in mind."
It was also coming from a sense of guiltーeven though I promised Koharu that I would be hers for three days, I broke that promise briefly on the very first day.
"Well then, good night."
"Good night…"
Borrowing Koharu's lap, I shut my eyes that have been overwhelmed by heavy sleepiness and devise tomorrow's plans in my head using whatever's left of my fading consciousness.
…Given that I didn't take a shower before falling asleep, I'll have to wake up at 7 AM at the latest so I can take one.
After that, we'll make breakfast together, enjoy it together, and spend the little time we have together leisurely.
Finally, we'll prepare to head out, leave my apartment together and head to work.
When that time comes, I imagine I'll be the one who will be holding Koharu's bag, which will be so heavy that it'll threaten to break my arm.
…After all, right now, there's no doubt that Koharu will cram whatever luggage she has in my room into her bag.
"Senpai…"
"Won't we… do it?"
"Thank you for taking care of me for these past three days. I really feel so happy."
Between the Koharu that I'm imagining and the Koharu who's caressing my head right now, I really can't tell which one of these is the real her.
"What about you? Don't you want to do it?"
"You can… come back again, you know?"
"Thank you… very much…"
At the very least… both sides of me are telling her the truth.
But only one of them can communicate with words, so in a way, there's no meaning to it.
"Does everyone have something to drink? Io wanted beer and Takeya-kun wanted wine… Takahiro, you will have to settle for oolong tea."
"Come on, just one cup wouldn't hurt, right? I'll be sober until night time with only that amount."
"You have the entrance exam next week… Ah, does everyone have their utensils? If anybody wants chopsticks, just say the word. I'll go get some for you…"
"Everything's alright, so that's enough, Setsuna. Stop being so fussy and sit down. …The party's never going to start at this rate."
"But I'm sitting right in the middle, on the seat of honor…"
"And this is your birthday party."
"Really, if the guest of honor is still going out of her way to do everything, we can't really calm down and celebrate, you know."
"O-Okay…"
"Whoa, this roast beef is great! How did you make it so juicy?"
"See, Setsuna, it's because you're like this he's forgetting his manners… Don't start eating before the toast!"

"This is amazing. You've become even better at cooking, Setsuna-chan. You're beautiful, and good at housework too… I've suspected as much, but perhaps there really are more than two genders in the world, right, Io?"
"I have no idea what you're talking about, and you certainly don't need to explain it either…"

"You're only learning how to make all these fancy dishes… The really important food you should be making when you have a family are dishes that you can eat every day and won't get tired of, such as nimono or ohitashi."
"Those dishes aren't suitable for parties though… Actually Mom, just go away."
"Really, it's guaranteed that you'll be a great wife, no doubt about it. And yet that bastard…"
"Takeya!"
"…! R-Right… Should we get started? …Does the Ogiso family sing Happy Birthday?"
"Well… in my case, we sang it until I entered high school, but now it's too embarrassing, so we stopped."
"…That means Setsuna did it until she entered university?"
"What kind of old-fashioned soap opera is this?"
"Well, whatever. Let's just keep it simple and go with a toast… Setsuna?"
"…We're starting, you know?"
"Ah… yeah, I'm sorry."
"Nee-chan… Kitahara-san is working all day, right? He won't be contacting you in the middle of the day."
"…! N-No. That's not what I'm doing… I'm just checking whether the phone's clock is out of sync…"
"These days the time on your phone won't go out of sync."
"…Alright, let's get started, shall we?"
"I'll be going ahead～"
"Good work～"
"Good work."
"Yeah, good work. Ah, and thank you, Iiyama-san."
"You're welcome. You've always helped me out after all, Kitahara-san. See you."
Working in the kitchen ended up dulling my sense of time, and it was only when the folks from the morning shift started leaving that I realized that it was already evening.
When I opened my mouth for the first time in a while and glanced at the window, I found out the natural light outside had already disappeared.
Though, well, putting that aside for now…
"…Did I do something to warrant the two of you glaring at me?"
The kitchen feels awfully cold despite the fact that the heater's turned on and there are stoves being used.
"You got chocolate from Iiyama-san as well, huh…"
"That's the third one you've received, Kitahara-san… Damn it, it seems I've finally been beaten."
"I'd say you're still lucky, Honda-kun. I only got a single piece of Chocobaby from Nakagawa-san."
"…No matter how you look at it, isn't it obvious that she was just joking around?"
It's true that I did receive a box of chocolates, though it was only Chocobaby, as I thought.
"I'm sure you will get yours on the actual day. It must be because I won't come tomorrow."
"Iiyama-san doesn't have a shift tomorrow… so she won't come either."
"…Ah～ I see."
It's the 13th of February.
The interior of the restaurant is filled with the slightest sense of anticipation on the eve of the sudden and exciting celebration that will happen tomorrow.
That's partially due to the fact that the restaurant's having a rather special dessert menu centered on chocolate, but there are also personal reasons aside from that…
"Nakagawa-san's different, so she gave everyone chocolates, but Mizuhara-san only gave chocolates to two people. While Iiyama-san only gave chocolates to you, Kitahara-san…"
"…Why are you keeping tabs on everyone's movements?"
"Is it wrong? Because I am the acting manager. It's only natural to keep an eye on my employees, right? …Indeed, I am a sore loser. Something wrong with that!?"
"You're going to be the official branch manager starting in spring, so it's not like you can make a move on the girls who work here to begin with…"
"Now that you mention it, I haven't received any chocolate from Sugiura-san either!"
"Obviously, I didn't either."
"Don't worry. I didn't get any from her either. She's just not the type to do such things."
…I did catch her buying some, though.
"So, Koharucchi. Why didn't you give any to Kitahara-san?"
"I didn't give them to anyone. Why are you being so specific?"
"After all, even if you did give some to the other boys, they'd obviously be obligatory, right?"
"I don't have any interest in Valentine's Day. I never gave any to my classmates either."
"What a waste～! But you're just so cute despite being a class rep, Koharucchi～"
"I'm glad you're praising me, but please don't look down on class reps without any basis."
"He already got his fourth from Aya-chan, you know? You're the only one who didn't give him any, you know."
"Again, what of it? That's none of my business, now, is it?"
"…Are you so confident because you already know he loves you the most?"
"If you care that much about Valentine's, how about giving everyone better chocolates, Floor Manager?"
"Well～ this month is so tight. If I were to have better chocolates on my hands, I'd gladly eat them for dinner, you see～"
"Then let's work harder so you can afford tastier meals. The dinner rush is about to begin, you know?"
"…Looks like I don't have any other choice."
"Well, I'm not giving any to classmates specifically, though."
"By the way, Takahiro… What happened to bringing your girlfriend along?"
"What do you mean, girlfriend? All I said was that I'll invite two or three girls from my class."
"Well, I don't mind whichever is the case… I came to the party today mostly because you told me you'd ask them over, you know?"
"W-Well～ I invited them, but y'know… they all completely turned me down because of their part-time jobs and other reasons."
"Come on… You haven't learned a single thing I taught you, have you～?"
"Well, I can't suddenly catch up to you, Iizuka-san. It's all about experience…"
"With practice comes experience. Believe it or not, my first target was my school's first-year homeroom teacher…"
"Really? Really!? Are you serious!? Tell me in detail!"
"…Say, wouldn't it be better for those two not to meet each other? I'm starting to worry about Takahiro-kun's future."
"…Setsuna."
"Eh? Ah, sorry. I wasn't listening."
"If you're really that bothered by it, you could have just held the party when he was free… I thought I already told you that before."
"That's not it… no, I suppose maybe it is, but I couldn't do it because I was scared."
"You're scared? What's wrong?"
"I'm scared of learning that the reason why he hasn't come today isn't simply because he's busy."
"And I know I'm disappointed, but I also know that a part of me feels relieved by this."
"You're scared of arriving at a conclusion?"
"As someone who brushed away his hand, yes."
"…Get it together! There's nothing you can do about what you've done in the past. You're supposed to be thinking about how you two can get back together, right?"
"You're right. You're really right…"
"That's why I'll try just a little bit… I want to put in just a little bit more effort."
"You're amazing, Iizuka-san. I respect you even more now. …Though I don't think I can be like you."
"…It's quite a fond memory of mine as of today. She taught me that tying them down was a fool's errandーtruly a turning point of my life."
"Yeah, I'm glad I didn't bring the girls. I don't know how many of them you'd have devoured."
"W-W-Wait!? Did you hear what I just said!?"
"I was properly listening until the twentieth girl…"
"I also told you my policies and way of life, right!? I won't hit on a friend's girlfriend! Setsuna-chan is a good example of that, right?"
"And it's not like they're my girlfriends… They just have a bit of a drama going on right now."
"…Are you saying you want them to reconcile? You want to involve yourself in something as extremely terrifying as a conflict between women?"
"Because I'm the class rep, even if it was forced on me. And the class' atmosphere is pretty bad right now."
"In a way, you really do seem quite composed despite the fact that you have entrance exams this weekend."
"Ah, right. Since we're here, can I ask for some advice? They'll be your precious underclassmen attending the same campus next year anyway."

"I don't really mind, but I don't think I'll be really useful. I know full well that I'm really not meant to put out fires like these. …Mostly because I'm aware that I'm the one who sets them off more often than not."
"Well, then how about the ladies? …Mizusawa-san, Nee-chan, hear me out, please."
"Hm?"
"What's wrong, Takahiro?"
"There's something troubling me right now. …It's about the girls in my class."
"Hmmm…"
